config.tacz_tactical_hud.anchor_x.desc: Horizontal position of the HUD center, as a share of the screen width
config.tacz_tactical_hud.anchor_y.desc: Vertical position of the HUD center, as a share of the screen height
config.tacz_tactical_hud.background_opac: Opacity of the dark panel background
config.tacz_tactical_hud.enabled.desc: Show the 3D HUD in this view instead of the classic gun HUD
config.tacz_tactical_hud.fov.desc: Field of view of the HUD camera. Lower values flatten the perspective
config.tacz_tactical_hud.gui_scale.desc: Auto follows the screen height; x1..x4 render the HUD as if the GUI scale were 1..4
config.tacz_tactical_hud.hide_experience: Hide the experience bar and level while the 3D HUD is shown
config.tacz_tactical_hud.hide_food.desc: Hide the food bar while the 3D HUD is shown
config.tacz_tactical_hud.hide_health_arm: Hide vanilla hearts and armor while the 3D HUD shows them
config.tacz_tactical_hud.hide_hotbar.des: Hide the hotbar and the selected item name while the 3D HUD is shown
config.tacz_tactical_hud.sway_strength.d: How strongly the HUD lags behind camera rotation, 0 disables the sway
config.tacz_tactical_hud.tilt.desc: Rotation around the horizontal axis. Negative values push the top edge away
config.tacz_tactical_hud.yaw.desc: Rotation around the vertical axis. Positive values push the right edge away, negative values the left edge
message.tacz_tactical_hud.cloth_missing: Install Cloth Config to edit the HUD in game, or edit config/tacz_tactical_hud-client.toml
